BrochureContent.Content: A luxurious three bedroom detached dormer residence in one of the most sought after locations in Rosslare Strand, offering breathtaking sea views and views of Rosslare Strand and Harbour. The home is beautifully presented throughout, with an exceptional sense of space, light, and modern comfort. The rear patio area is a private haven — sheltered, sun filled, and perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The Entrance Porch opens through French doors into a bright, spacious open plan Kitchen/Dining/Living area, where natural light pours in from multiple directions. Additional French doors lead directly to the private patio, capturing the coastal atmosphere and offering sensational sea views. An organised utility room provides excellent storage and functionality. The downstairs bedroom is beautifully finished and includes its own Ensuite, ideal for guests or convenient ground floor living. Ascending the staircase, you are greeted by an abundance of light and sumptuous space. The first floor opens into a stunning lounge, complete with French doors leading to a balcony that enjoys breathtaking views of Rosslare Strand and Rosslare Harbour – a truly standout feature of the home. Two further gorgeous double bedrooms are located on this level, one with its own Ensuite, along with a beautifully finished family bathroom, completing the luxurious accommodation. The property is superbly positioned within walking distance of Kelly’s Resort Hotel, several exceptional local coffee shops, and Rosslare’s Blue Flag beach, which is just minutes walk away. Everyday amenities, including shops, restaurants, and Rosslare Golf Club, are also close by. The location offers excellent connectivity, situated approximately 12 km from Wexford Town, 4 km from Rosslare Harbour, and just 6 km from the M11, providing a direct route to Dublin and onward access to the M50 in around 1 hour 45 minutes. Viewing is highly recommended.
